home.heroSubtitle: AI keenya seenaa du'a keessan qora, dadhabbii mul'isa, erga ga'aa hojii abjuu argachuuf gargaarsa ta'e kenna.
home.aiPoweredDesc: AI keenya seenaa du'a keessan qora, yaada guutuu qabiyyee, ijaarsa fi saalaa kenna.
home.atsDesc: Seenaa du'a keessan sirna qorannoo filannoo irraa gahuuf teessoo kenna.
home.actionableDesc: Seenaa du'a keessan cimsuuf fi gaaffii ga'aa dabalatuuf yaada adeemsa kenna.
home.keyFeaturesSubtitle: Waan hojii wajjin walsimuu hubachuuf, CV fooyyessuuf, fi gara af-gaaffiitti saffisaan deemuu barbaachisu hunda.
home.threeStepsSubtitle: CV jalqabaa irraa gara galmee hojii irratti xiyyeeffateetti adeemsa qajeelfamaan deemi.
home.step1Desc: CVSmart muuxannoo kee akka hubatuuf faayila PDF, DOCX, yookaan TXT kee nagaan dabali.
home.step2Desc: Ibsa hojii galchi; cimina, hanqina, fi walsimannaa ATS irratti xiinxala xiyyeeffate argadhu.
home.step3Desc: Draft CV fooyya'e uumi, template ogummaa filadhu, PDF qulqulluu baasi.
home.ctaSubtitle: CV kee xiinxali, sirreeffama bu'a qabeessa adda baasi, daqiiqaa muraasa keessatti CV hojii irratti xiyyeeffate uumi.
